verdict.rationale: Spline is a web SaaS design tool with a developer Code API, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path, and the docs describe the developer surface as a JavaScript runtime library with no REST API and no machine-readable spec. The llms.txt index and MCP server are separate capabilities and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
